D: A timid young dinosaur gets lost far from his family's farm and makes friends with a human boy.
P: Serve the mains when Arlo helps fill the family silo with corn.
S: Pan fried corn fritters with spring onion and chives
Corn kernels mixed with flour, egg and spring onion, fried in spoonfuls until golden, served with a sour cream and chive dip.
Blueberries, raspberries and blackberries with honey and lime, over cream
Blueberries, raspberries and blackberries tossed with a little honey and lime, spooned into small bowls with whipped cream.
Arlo and Spot watching the fireflies light up the field

Sweet potato wedges roasted with smoked paprika and maple until caramelised at the edges, with a cool lime and chive sour cream dip. Cut 1kg sweet potatoes into wedges and toss with 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp smoked paprika, salt and pepper. Spread on 2 lined trays and roast at 220C for 25 minutes, turning once. Drizzle with 1 tbsp maple syrup and roast 5 minutes more until the edges caramelise. Mix 200g sour cream with the zest and juice of 1 lime and a handful of chopped chives. Serve the wedges hot with the dip.
M: Short ribs rubbed with paprika and pepper, cooked low for five hours
Beef short ribs rubbed with paprika, pepper and salt, cooked low at 140C for 5 hours, served with charred corn and coleslaw.
A bowl for the boy Arlo named Spot.

Bacon, onion and potato softened, corn and stock added and simmered 20 minutes, finished with cream and chives. Fry 200g diced bacon until crisp, then add 1 diced onion and 2 celery sticks and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 500g diced potato, the kernels from 4 corn cobs and 1L chicken stock and simmer 20 minutes until the potato is soft. Blitz a third of the soup and stir it back in to thicken. Add 150ml cream, season and heat through. Serve in bowls with chopped chives and buttered crusty bread.
W: Cornmeal, flour, buttermilk, egg and melted butter mixed briefly, baked in a hot cast iron pan at 220C for 20 minutes, served with honey butter.
K: Farm stand watermelon and mint cooler
Blended watermelon with lime and mint, strained

Fresh watermelon blitzed with lime and mint, strained, topped with sparkling water and poured over ice in a big jug to share. Blitz 1.2kg seedless watermelon flesh with the juice of 2 limes and a small handful of mint leaves until smooth. Strain through a sieve into a big jug and stir in 1 tbsp honey if the melon isn't sweet. Chill for 30 minutes. Fill the jug with ice and top with 400ml sparkling water. Pour into 4 glasses with a watermelon wedge and mint sprig each.

s.note: Pan fried corn fritters with spring onion and chives
s.how: Mix a drained can of corn with 100g flour, 2 eggs, sliced spring onions and salt. Fry spoonfuls in a little oil until golden on both sides. Stir chopped chives through sour cream for the dip and serve the fritters warm.

s.note: Blueberries, raspberries and blackberries with honey and lime, over cream
s.how: Toss 125g each of blueberries, raspberries and blackberries with a spoon of honey and a squeeze of lime. Spoon over whipped cream in small bowls. Berries a wild boy might bring you from the forest.

m.note: Short ribs rubbed with paprika and pepper, cooked low for five hours
m.how: Rub 2kg beef short ribs with smoked paprika, cracked pepper and salt. Cook at 140C for 5 hours until tender with a dark crust. Serve with charred corn cobs and a crunchy cabbage coleslaw, like the T-rex ranchers would.

w.how: Mix 150g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, an egg, 300ml buttermilk and 50g melted butter until just combined. Bake in a hot greased cast iron pan at 220C for 20 minutes. Serve wedges with butter beaten with honey.
